newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Telepri sells Telecel stake 14,500 esc/shr.
newsitem.headline: Telepri sells Telecel stake 14,500 esc/shr.

text.p: The Telepri-Telecomunicacoes Privadas consortium said it sold a 10 percent stake in Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel for 14,500 escudos per share.
Earlier, a Banco Essi official said that a group of domestic and foreign institutional investors had bought the stake from Telepri, which includes the Espirito Santo and Amorim groups.
"Telepri sold the stake it held in Telecel via a banking consortium grouping Banco Essi, Warburg and Lehman Brothers, at a price of 14,500 escudos per share," Telepri said in a statement.
"The shares were acquired by institutional investors, many of them already shareholders of the company who reinforced their positions," the statement said.
"Accelerated bookbuilding was adopted to achieve the sale in the space of a day, as demand comfortably exceeded supply," it added.
Telecel shares closed at 14,700 escudos, up two, in volume of 2,844,611 shares on Lisbon bourse.
